description: A bearded man in a tall black hat and black cloak with a white collar and a star-shaped order on his chest sits in a red velvet chair in the foreground, holding a silver-topped cane and a folded paper. Behind him, a guard with a halberd stands in the shadows. Tiers of seated men in black caps and black gowns look on from wooden benches in a dim, vaulted hall lit by a shaft of light from above. The painting fills the frame edge to edge, with no visible text, border or wall.
